reviews.text: I bring my Great Pyrenees in for Groomers' Baths and he always comes out looking and smelling incredible! I have to request fragrance-free and gentler options for his sensitive skin + coat and they're always receptive to his needs. Everyone there is super kind and helpful :)

My mini dachshund looked precious after her grooming - bedazzled and dressed to the nines in her pink scarf with roll cake print.   Everything went smoothly.
Prior to her grooming, I dropped her off for doggy daycare. The facility was clean and my dog loved it! She was exhausted afterward. I will definitely go back. Great spot.
They did a great job!
Thank You!! 💙💙 …
Great very happy
The friendliest staff and they were so kind. They took such great care of our pup and made our first visit amazing.

First time visiting and definitely won’t be the last. Our little guy is generally a bit fearful (he’s a rescue) but he did very well! The women were so sweet and gentle with him. He looks so cute and the price is right. Highly recommend.
It's not a chain and even stocks our dog food — my kind of place! A perfect addition to 7th Ave, offering a charming throwback to the neighborhood before the rise of corporations.
Fantastic place. Treated him with so much love and kindness. Definitely recommend for a puppy’s first cut.
Great service! Got me in right away last minute and did a wonderful job cleaning my dog (his first grooming experience) and moose came out smiling and with an adorable bandana.
Love this place! Definitely will come back!

HomeDoggy has been amazing in so many respects aside from grooming and boarding. We have a very anxious and spirited wire fox terrier who was thrown out by many groomers and trainers. We didn’t think we would be able to send him to another groomer so one day took him to a walk-in dog bathing place in Park Slope. The Owner (Rodrigo) happened to be there. He asked if I would like them to groom Ollie instead of doing it myself. I warned him of Ollies personality and he seemed unfazed. He picked him up/ tucked him under his arm and said come back in a couple of hours. So - I walked out to enjoy a few free hours and upon my return saw a new dog. He was beautifully clean, fluffy and so calm!!!

Needless to say I was hooked on HomeDoggy from that 1st experience. Rodrigo is truly a dog whisperer and my god does our family need that. Next we decided to try boarding Ollie so we could take a long overdue vacation. Ollie stayed a month with HomeDoggy. They knew and understood his issues. I know that must have been a long month for them :-)) Not one complaint or negative report. When we picked him up he was calm and slept for days from all the fun he had. We love knowing that when he boards there he is also getting a vacation.

As soon as we pull up to HomeDoggy Ollie’s tail starts to wag and he tries to open the car door himself. It is truly his home away from home and has been for 7+ years.

Thank you HomeDoggy for everything you do  - Rodrigo and his team are truly the best!!
Emily gets my dog RIGHTTTT. 10/10 highly recommend. She makes my little one feel safe and comfortable.

updated review: This place seems to be going down hill. Been taking my pup for grooming for the last few years. I have always given them another chance but there is always a time issue -more than 4 hours is a very long time. Most recently my pup came back with one long haired leg and one short haired leg, overall very shabby job. looked very messy. I think it’s time to move on.

Had my cavapoo groomed here - I was concerned that she would need to be shaved because of her matting but the groomer did a great job!  Wait times can be a little long but would recommend.
Our goldendoodle puppy (5 months) got her first haircut/bath here. The staff did a great job of making her feel comfortable and she looks great!
Thank you!!!💙💙 …
Excellent service and such kind people! My dog had a great spa day here, and looked very fabulous when I picked him up. Thank you!

Maria is incredible! My dog and I had some negative experiences at our prior groomer and I was hesitant to try a new place. I called Homedoggy and they assured me they would handle my pup with care and when I dropped him off he was already calmer! And he looks great. Thank you Homedoggy and Maria!!

Absolutely DO NOT bring your dog here for grooming. I have been bringing my beagle here for a number of years for the occasional nail trim, anal gland expression and bath.

Most times they have done a decent job, the groomer was a nice young lady and I didn’t have any issues.

Last week I brought my dog for a nail trim and anal gland expression. This time the groomer was a young man who I hadn’t seen before.

I didn’t notice upon picking my dog up but the next day I noticed three of her nails were clipped too short and had filled with blood.

She was also in a lot of pain constantly licking her rear and nails, and a day later a huge abscess formed on her anal gland.

I took her to the emergency vet and had to get her anal gland drained and put her on antibiotics, a $300 vet bill.

This all was caused by the glands not being properly emptied by the groomer.

DO NOT bring your pet here if you care for their health and safety.
"My dog came home looking and smelling amazing. The groomers were patient, caring, and made the whole process stress-free."
Service to my dog was great they did a great job grooming him but it cost me $150 he's 14 lbs that is way too much to spend on a small dog grooming

This was our first time at HomeDoggy as we recently moved into the neighborhood and we are very happy with how our mini bernedoodle’s groom and teeth brushing went! Marcus did an amazing job with his cut based on the photo we provided beforehand

My friend recommended this place to me and it did not disappoint! I took my Maltese Bella for a haircut and wash — they gave her the most adorable teddy bear cut and treated her with care and attention. They even sent me a video to make sure I could share feedback before I picked her up (I had no notes!). Staff is incredibly friendly! Will definitely be coming back.
Wonderful job!
They did so much of a good job I didn’t even notice my dog, I will always bring my dog to this spot. This the best make over I’ve ever seen
They look GREAT!!
HomeDoggy did a great job grooming our long haired cat. She looks and feels great and would recommend!

Marcos is very helpful, accommodating, and very pleasant. Carolina did an amazing job on my poodle and golden doodle. They look absolutely adorable. The girls were not stressed. They came home calm and happy. Thank you so much!
We‘ve been grooming our samoyed at home for years but we are so glad that we tried with Homedoggy and happily found the place we trust for our fur baby.
Always an excellent experience! Emily and Maria are amazing groomers and our dog has always been completely at ease.
Thank you so much ❤️🥰 …
Just picked up my Havanese puppy from his first gooming ever and boy is he happy and handsome! Thank you for making his first experience with a groomer a great one!

Unprofessional and deceptive. Quoted one price after thoroughly discussing my dog's size, weight and breed. They saw the dog at drop off and we again discussed his haircut and the price. When I arrived to pick him up, the price was suddenly 50% more.

The owner also bizarrely berated me for getting my dog a haircut in the fall.
Otis, my Havanese, always comes out looking and feeling like a million bucks after his grooming. We love home doggy. Thanks

I will defenetetly keep HomePuppy as my Pooche's groomer.

This was probably my best experience of Bruno getting groomed ever and he’s been my baby for five years now. The groomer Marcus and Marcos who is running the business spent 20 minutes talking to me about how Bruno should be groomed. Sadly, not many groomers in New York City know how to groom Giant Schnauzers but we were so fortunate because Marcus is an award-winning Groomer. The atmosphere was lovely, inviting and the process super  straightforward. I also appreciated how I was asked about a special conditioner/shampoo option, instead of being charged after the fact. I am really grateful and will be returning in a couple of months

Paid over $200 for a bath. No sanitary trim, paw pads, nail trim, nothing. Literally just bathed her. Then tried to charge double what they quoted me over the phone ($180 for bath + cut, including first time discount) after I shared my dog’s breed, age, and weight — for the very purpose of getting an estimate before booking. Realizing now after reading past reviews this isn’t the first time they’ve done this. Complete scam.
Always great dogs have from! Staff amazing!!!!

I have been taking Ruby to homeDoggy since she is a puppy, they always did a good job and she likes it there. Ruby is now two years old. Yesterday, Marcus did the most incredible job grooming Rubby, she never look so good. I truly recommend tis place.  Everyone there is wonderful with a great vibe.
I travel 2miles to have my dog groomed by home doggy. Carolina is the best.

We took our schnauzer to doggy home and she came out looking great. We are so thrilled with the service. The price was very fair. I would highly recommend, especially for schnauzer owners. I was recommended their grooming services!
Nice place good people! Five star 👍🏻 …

Thank you for your business ❤️
trusted neighborhood spot for doggy daycare
Homedoggy did a great job bathing our dog. He is very nervous and hates baths, but they handled him gently and professionally. Will definitely return for future grooming.
top 5 service! she left my cocoa so cute! i’d recommend it. looks how adorable 🥹
Obrigado and we can’t wait to see Coco again 🥰 …
My German Shepherd is happy and looking good and smelling good. I was recommended to this place and they did an amazing service! Maggie says thank you.
DONT TAKE YOUR DOG HERE THEY ARE THE WORST AND THEY BLOCKED ME ON SOCIAL MEDIA the cut a whole patch into my sisters dog and blocked us on social media and still charged her

HomeDoggy has been a fantastic home for grooming for our pup since we moved to Park Slope last year! The staff is responsive and friendly and they help our Goldendoodle look her best. She always turns heads when we leave their shop!
God bless.. and thank you

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE !!!!

I am writing to formally express my deep dissatisfaction and serious concern regarding my recent experience with Homedoggy.

Prior to my appointment, I was clearly quoted $220 plus tax for services. When I arrived to pick up my dog, I was unexpectedly told the total was $359 plus tax, a substantial increase from the agreed price. I was never contacted about additional charges, nor did I approve any change in pricing.

When I questioned the discrepancy, I was told that if I did not pay the $359 plus tax, my dog would not be released. Being placed in a position where my pet was withheld unless I paid an amount I never agreed to is completely unacceptable and deeply disturbing.

After I objected to what I consider fraudulent pricing behavior, I was told that they would never service my dog again. To then, after all of this, have the nerve to ask for a tip was beyond unprofessional.

At no point did anyone acknowledge how inappropriate it was to threaten non-release of my dog over a disputed charge. The entire interaction felt coercive, unethical, and handled with a shocking lack of professionalism.

I expect transparency in pricing, proper communication before additional charges are added, and respectful treatment. None of those standards were met.

We absolutely love Homedoggy! Our little Zoe always comes out looking so pawfect! 🥰 Being a mom of 2 kids and a fur pup, sometimes we are running late or have to reschedule due to life’s speed bumps. They are always willing to work with us and are the sweetest. The staff are always so welcoming. Highly recommend for any fur babies! …

Thank you very much. ❤️
Thank you very much 🙏 …

I have been going to HomeDoggy for about 4yrs now. I have two dogs, one who at times is not so friendly but the staff at homedoggy still treats her with so much love and affection, she could do wrong in their eyes 😂. I love the way they cut her hair and always completely satisfied. I would highly recommend HomeDoggy.

My dog who is always super eager to meet new people and dogs and will happily go into any establishment was behaving normally the first time he went to Homedoggy for grooming but was extremely hesitant and essentially had to be dragged in the second time which makes me suspicious of how he may have been treated. (He also is fine with baths in general). I also was unable to meet the people grooming my dog and speak with them directly. I was told they speak Spanish only and when I expressed that that wouldn't be an issue, I was told they are "too busy" to come speak with us which I found very strange and suspicious. Pet owners should be able to see and have a direct conversation with groomers. I also don't think the groomers ahve any formal training based on conversations I've had with the receptionist. They also are not very punctual and failed to communicate with us they were running late so we arrived to pick up our dog and were told to go back home and return 1.5 hours later. The grooming itself was okay (my dog got the groomer's bath twice) but they products they use do smell very strongly.

He also did a trial for doggy day care at Homedoggy and came home with an abrasion in his left inguinal area. Homedoggy failed to inform us of any events that may have led to this on site, were pretty dismissive when we inquired about any dog bites/aggressive play/etc they may have noticed, reported they don't have cameras on site to review (they should), and had the arrogance to tell me it my dog's abrasion was "a rash" with no medical/veterinary training to support their inaccurate diagnosis.

Three stars for grooming itself though the communication, punctuality, and on-site care left something to be desired from us and our dog based on his nervousness to enter.

Had our pup board with HomeDoggy for 5 nights. He clearly had the time of his life because he came back so relaxed, happy, and napped for two days because of all the play time he got with other dogs. We had him bathed for pick up and have never seen him so clean and fluffy! Homedoggy was very communicative and would always give us updates when we asked. Will definitely be coming back soon!
It’s our pleasure and thank you for bringing Rex into our daycare every day and a bath every week. God bless you❤️
Ruby looks so cute and was in such a happy mood when we picked her up! We have found a new groomer!

They did a phenomenal job of making my baby look ADORABLE!!!!

I have been grooming Coco myself for the past 3 years, as the one time I took her to the groomers (another spot in park slope), even though I told them the cut I wanted, they did their own thing and I hated the cut she got.

I decided to try again with home doggy.  I told them specifically what I wanted and they followed through beautifully! Just like I had asked!
It's a lifesaver the fact that for the daycare, after the first test it's just a walk-in and I can drop my dog there without booking.
My puppy was drop off at homedoggy and came back looking brand new and smelling even better

Yulieth worked wonders on our pup Charlie (Cavapoo)! She did a great job getting rid of his mats, making his fur SUPER soft, and trimming his beard/face.

We've taken Charlie to many different groomers and this was the best cut he’s ever had by far. We’ve requested to use Yulieth for all our appointments going forward!

Check the before and after photos to see him go from a shag rug to refined little gentleman 😂😂😂

A friend recommended me to this place so I decided to take a chance and bring bella to HomeDoggy I dropped her off 11 AM and she was ready by 3:30. That’s great. But when I went, to paid  the bill was $172  wow I didn’t expect that for 12 pound Shitzu. So I asked the worker in the front desk why the price is so high. He said she was matted  in some areas it’s $20 for dematting I told him he should’ve called since dematting  could be pretty rough on a dog It depends how they do it. The groomer show me a video of the matted hair I guess that’s OK. On my way out with Bella I noticed her backside was full of poop  what happened? I took her home and cleaned her up. for my  first time experience at HomeDoggy wasn’t that good?  There should be Clear communication with the owner   if any issues come up by calling the owner and  price could be a little lower. bring Bella here again?

Hi! My dog Romeo had a groomer bath at Homedoggy and I noticed he had some dry skin under his armpits. The team recommended their medicated shampoo, and it worked wonders! After just two medicated baths during his grooming sessions, the dryness completely disappeared. I really love this place and the amazing staff!
Three years ago, Luca, my dog and I moved from Boston to Park Slope.  My now 5yr.old poodle and I were lucky to live around the corner from HomeDoggy.  Both groomers and day/night staff are the best.
Homedoggy gave my doggos a great groom! They look so handsome, thank you.

I absolutely LOVE Homedoggy! I take my dog there for daycare and occasional boarding, and I never have to worry because I know he is well taken care of. He is always so excited to see all the staff, and sometimes when I'm out walking him, we'll run into walkers from Homedoggy and they know him immediately. One time when I let them know my dog had been sick, they thoughtfully called me the next day just to check on how he was doing because the staff was worried about him. I would recommend them to anyone!

Very pleased with this grooming salon
Everything went smoothly and it was quiet and groomer was so kind and mellow . Frankie really loves his new look and says his experience was positive ++++!!’

Took my baby Louis for his birthday and I swear I've never seen him so happy before  Carolina from the staff really took good care of my boy. Also Santiago the manages is always super nice and helpful with Louis. He kept me posted on his process and treated Louis with a blueberry face mask for his bday!!!! Louis is coming back soon guys!
Thank you very much for your review 🙌 …

President Pancake Panda the Corgi and his brother Oliver absolutely love HomeDoggy. The blueberry facial keeps Pancake’s cheeks fresh, and the deshedding treatment works wonders on their coats. They always get the VIPup treatment with playtime, extra love, and stylish bandanas. Every visit leaves them looking and feeling their best. 🩷🩷

Dropped my 2 dogs off at this place for 10 days. Picked up both dogs less than a week ago and they both are extremely sick, they weren’t home for 24 hours before the coughing started and now one dog continues throwing up. Sent message to “homedoggy” 2 days ago and still no response, please be extremely careful leaving animals there. For the price of over 2k I expected my dogs to be good health.
Our dog have been going to HD for a few years now for grooming and boarding. We won’t trust anybody else to care for them.. Thank you all at HD💖💖 …
As a doggy grandmother I bring the 85 pound dog here for grooming and he always comes back relaxed and happy and looking beautiful.

I been going to Homedoggy for 2 years. They are professional on ALL levels. I have experience every service they offer,  but their are two that stands out the most. 1. Grooming and 2. Boarding.  They treat my son, as if he belongs to them. I will never leave,  and the only way I would, if they go out of business
Thank you so much, Sade! We hope to see you and your pup soon!❤️

We love homedoggy! Have been coming here since our dog Howard was a puppy so about 4.5 years. He always comes out looking so fresh and clean. The staff is so extremely friendly and it’s reassuring that our boy is in such good hands. He’s a cairn terrier so he requires a hand stripping haircut and they always do a great job. Recently, wanted to have his face trimmed a bit more than usually and just provided a picture reference and when we picked him up it was exactly as requested. Groomers bathing always great as well, never disappointed. Highly recommend!

Our Labradoodle received a fantastic cut, best he's got in 6 years. Only downside was communication re pick up-- took longer than maximum time (4.5 hours), and still waited 20min for pick up.
Could just be one time hiccup- will definitely come back

The staff is amazing.  My dog Oliver loves to go there for boarding, grooming and day care. I have had my dog for over 6 years. I will not leave  him with anyone else. Excellent all around!!
Migdalia

He’s a rescue who was living on the street for about year before we found each other so he has his traumas and is a bit temperamental. You guys know how to treat him and are super patient with him because he always comes back looking super dapper and happy. You have a forever client with us!
I trust HomeDoggy with my baby. They have never given me a reason not too. They're attentive, sweet and she comes back to me happy and tired out. Perfect.

I cannot say enough great things about Home Doggy and the amazing grooming Massimo, my Wire Fox Terrier, received from Jose! Handstripping a Wire Fox Terrier is no easy task, but Jose handled it with such skill and professionalism. Massimo looks absolutely stunning, his coat is perfectly trimmed, and you can tell the work was done with great care and attention to detail.

Not only does he look like he’s ready for the spring/summer, but he also seemed calm and happy afterward, which speaks volumes about how gentle and caring Jose was throughout the grooming process. I truly appreciate the level of expertise and love that went into Massimo’s handstripping and trim.

Highly recommend Home Doggy if you’re looking for top-tier grooming, especially for breeds that need specialized care. Thank you, Jose and all the amazing staff of HomeDoggy.

What a nice job the folks at Homedoggy did for Theo's grooming.  They turned our beloved boy back into the handsome doggy who was under all of that hair.  Theo was treated with care and kindness and appears to have had a stress-free experience during his grooming.  Our advice: be specific as to the type of grooming you want.  The folks at Homedoggy will not disappoint.  Great Job!

Simply the best !!!! My fur babies came out looking as cute as ever !! You can tell the groomers take their time and make sure your fur babies feel safe and comfortable during their grooming session. 10/10 recommend !! <3

I've been bringing my pomeranian and terrier mix here for the last year for bath & teeth brushing. Have been super happy with the results every time. The staff is always very friendly/accommodating and my pups seem very well taken care of. Would definitely recommend!
Excellent service

im obsessed with this place! My dog always looks so good. I also appreciate how knowledgeable and kind the staff is! Make sure to go when Santiago is there, he is the best!

I got my dog groomed and he looks great!  A nice cut and he seems happy too.  The staff was a pleasure to talk to and they listened on any concerns I had. I will definitely bring my dog back there again.

Unfortunately I cannot recommend this groomer. I had an emergency and had to reschedule. They told me they would wave the cancellation fee this time. I rescheduled for the very next day. I went it and in passing as they took her back they asked “do you want us to try to brush her teeth?” I said yes. When I checked out they charged me 50.00 for the “waived” cancellation fee, 30.00 for the teeth brushing. When I asked about the fee he said “oh I didn’t say that” cherry on top was that 3 days after my dog got a bacterial infection on her neck and shoulders. The groomer said they could not offer a refund. Not transparent, honest, or willing to make a very expensive issue right. 1 star.

Rodrigo,
Let me first clear this up, YOU and I never met, because if we had I wouldn't be wasting my time typing with an internet gangsta like yourself.

Clearly you didn't read the post entirely. I stated that we received a partial refund. After all this time you would assume that this is about a refund? Small minds never see the bigger picture. It was never about the money, it's about the service that your business claims to provide and how in 3 days our doggie was traumatized!

This is why you have your very own REDDIT thread! Trust me if you this all of these people are worried about a refund, you would be broke from all the lawsuits.

Defend yourself as much as you like, just face the fact that your shop provides terrible service. You could respond if you like, however I would read the reviews and make the changes necessary. Its not about you and never was, spend less time being sarcastic and more time making you business better.

I dropped off my parents Maltipoo for a much needed bath and grooming. I didn't recognize him when I picked him up he looked so good.  Gio is feisty to say the least and the team was so patient and kind with him. We will definitely be back in a few weeks.

To all that read these posts, please be advised to stay FAR FAR away from this establishment. Now before I begin, the owner's name is Rodrigo. Sir, I've read your responses and I will say, let's keep it civil.

Now that I got out of the way, let's begin.

In Aug of 2024, we took our very loveable Frenchie Sparty to HD for boarding for 3 days because we would be out of town. We also provided a weeks worth of food for him and it looks his food was shared because he lost 8pds in 3 days.We returned to pick him up, and got him home. He was traumatized. He was physically abused and bruised. He wouldn't eat or go to the bathroom. I took him to the vet. Her words were "Who did this to this dog?" She was appalled. My vet advised us to file a police report based on what she saw.
Sparty's left side was swollen, like he was kicked a few times. Lost weight and clearly traumatized.

While gathering all the information and nursing him, I decided to return to HD and get some answers. What I got was unaccountablilty, word salad and flat out lies. I was told that the owner wasn't there that day, however I found out through the woman at front desk sloppy reception skills that he was upstairs and refused to come downstairs. I normally try to handled things with a certain decorum, however when it comes to our pup, all that goes out window.

Rodrigo, Before you do you best internet gangsta routine. Let me remind i came to handle it like any concerned pet owner would. Now if you come of character in your response understand everyone reading this will agree with the actions that comes afterwards. Granted we were given a partial refund, but doesn't make up for the pain and suffering our pup endured in HD's supposed care.

My advice to all in the Park slope area and others who have used HD, just don't. If you value your pet appearance and health, find another place because this one isn't it. Now that being said, I welcome any response or explanation.

If you still are considering using Home Doggy, I would read REDDIT posts for HD to get more detailed testimony.
Staff is friendly, space is clean, and my dog is not scared when dropping him off.

We’ve been coming to Homedoggy for years. The entire staff is so friendly and welcoming and our Goodendoodle Artemis loves her time there. She’s always so happy when we drop her off which tells me they really take care of her. And her grooming always looks excellent when we pick her up. We are loyal customers who will continue to take our girl to Homedoggy!

I love this spot. First, my dog comes home smelling sooo good. Second, I have an Aussie so I’m very specific on no cutting certain area and they always listen never had a problem. Third, my pup gets really nervous with groomers, vets etc. and they handle her so well.

Thank you Homedoggy

Simply amazing!!! They pulled off an AKC show dog cut for my 6mo Poodle puppy!!! She suffered a terrible autoimmune attack (NOT contagious AT ALL, don’t worry) & lost a lot of skin and hair before she was treated. The vets absolutely butchered her coat treating her wounds. It was a real hack job, but medically necessary. On top of that, we could not groom her at all while she was on immunosuppressants for risk of illness or infection so her hair grew to about 3 inches w/ random shaved spots everywhere. We wanted to treat her with a special fancy haircut for all she’s been through. The groomer transformed her into such a beauty!! They were very kind and personable and even gave a little discount because we were first time customers. They are the best! Will definitely come back. Her fancy cut was priced high(understandably, and it was still a fair price for that cut), but originally our quote for a regular cut and groom was very reasonable! Everyone I’ve spoken to over the phone is very kind and communicative. They really seem to care about their everyone’s furbabies & the satisfaction of their clients.
PS - I typically never bother taking the time to write reviews, srsly. But Homedoggy deserves it!
